title: Mail labels
what: An account's labels, kept in the store and carried on messages as IMAP keywords of the service's own form, in src/labels.rs and src/routes/labels.rs.

title: Reading and changing mail
what: Mail read over IMAP: folders and their roles, pages by time window, threads, parts and bodies, the search box, a message's flags, labels and folder set whole, and deletion, in src/imap/ and the message and folder routes.

title: Filter rules and spam senders
what: An account's filter rules, checked, ordered by position, planned over a message's headers and carried out by flag and move, their runs over a folder, and its always-spam senders, in src/rules.rs and src/routes/filters.rs.

title: Writing and sending mail
what: Drafts started, changed and saved on the server under the Message-ID they keep, files attached, sends that wait out the account's undo span then go, read receipts, known addresses, the settings and the service's own words, in src/writing/.

title: Sender logos
what: A sender domain's logo, found in its BIMI record or its site's icons, fetched only from the open web, checked and kept in the store, in src/avatars/ and src/routes/avatar.rs.

title: Inbox watcher
what: One IMAP connection per account standing in IDLE on the inbox, running the rules over new mail and publishing message.created and folder.changed; the accounts file followed, in src/watcher/.
